svg.title: Red Yellow Blue V, 1968 — interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Tapering three-panel outline and joins approximated from two institution/dealer photographs; some perspective remains uncertain. It is a schematic study, not measured orthographic geometry. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary record: https://hirshhorn.si.edu/collection/artwork/?edanUrl=edanmdm%3Ahmsg_07.2; visual reference: https://matthewmarks.com/online/30-years-online; reviewed 2026-10-27; hand-authored interpretive study, not a facsimile; approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours.
